Bill.BriefDescription: Providing for a property tax exemption for the administrative offices of certain nonprofit organizations.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to a property tax exemption for the administrativeoffices of certain nonprofit organizations; and adding a new section tochapter 84.36 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 84.36 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The real and personal property used by a community orneighborhood nonprofit organization is exempt from taxation to theextent the property is used as an administrative office for theadministration of the charitable low and moderate-income housingprograms of the organization. The department of revenue shall providerules regarding administrative offices exempt under this section,consistent with the purposes of this section. The benefit of theexemption must inure to the user. (2) For the purposes of this section, "community or neighborhoodnonprofit organization" means: (a) An organization exempt under 26 U.S.C. Sec. 501(c)(3) of theinternal revenue code of 1986; and p. 1 HB 2675 (b) A community-based development organization or a communityhousing development organization, as defined by the United Statesdepartment of housing and urban development.
